publicQuestion: How many semistandard Young Tableaux are there of shape (13,10,9,7,4,3,1,1) with entries in {1,2,...,11}? Here, semistandard means entries weakly increase from left to right along each row and strictly increase from top to bottom down each column. Give just the integer.

judgeNote.validityReason: The shape and allowed entries are fully specified, so the count is a well-defined exact integer. It can be verified independently by the hook-content formula for semistandard Young Tableaux or by evaluating the corresponding Schur polynomial s_lambda(1^11) via Jacobi-Trudi.
